facebookresearch_sparsh/tactile_ssl/mode.review_custom_scheduler_classes: review the WarmupCosineScheduler and CosineWDSchedule classes for learning rate and weight decay scheduling strategies

facebookresearch_sparsh/tactile_ssl/mode.test_apply_mask: test the apply_mask method with tube or block mask types on multi-modal tensor inputs
facebookresearch_sparsh/tactile_ssl/mode.review_transcode: review the transcode method to understand shared versus per-modality attention block processing

facebookresearch_sparsh/tactile_ssl/mode.build_resnet18_encoder: build a ResNet-18 encoder with default pretrained weights and no final classification layer
facebookresearch_sparsh/tactile_ssl/mode.build_alexnet_encoder: build an AlexNet encoder with default pretrained weights and no final classification layer
facebookresearch_sparsh/tactile_ssl/mode.create_AlexnetWrapper: create an AlexnetWrapper module that wraps a pretrained AlexNet encoder for feature extraction

facebookresearch_sparsh/tactile_ssl/mode.build_vit_large_model: build a ViT-large vision transformer model with 1024 embed dim and 24 transformer blocks
facebookresearch_sparsh/tactile_ssl/mode.build_vit_predictor_model: build a VisionTransformerPredictor model for masked image modeling with sinusoidal positional encoding
facebookresearch_sparsh/tactile_ssl/mode.create_vit_with_registers: create a vision transformer with configurable register tokens for enhanced feature extraction
